note: City of Crete Parks & Rec campground in the 96-acre Tuxedo Park, west of the Big Blue River (the Saline County fairgrounds buildings are in the park, but the camping is city-run, not event-only). Two areas: 10 sites by the baseball field along Old Settlers Rd (20/30-amp) and 11 along the river on Cottonwood Rd (20/30/50-amp). --Claude
summary: City page (dated 2026) confirms ordinary first-come nights April-October at $15/day, 21 RV sites (stored 20), 50 A at the river sites, ~35-40 ft pads, 10-night max, showers, water, dump. Not waterfront stands (river pads behind a continuous treeline). Pin is across the river south of the bridge, ~250 m from the river pads; move suggested. Flag: the page calls the main entrance a '3 ton bridge'.
flags: INCLUSION passes (fair-ground rule): the city page sells ordinary nights to the public all season ('During the camping season (April -October), the park has ... 21 RV camping sites ... Fee is $15 per day on a first come, first serve basis'), dated by 'The dates for the 2026 Saline County Fair are July 14-19'. It does not say camping is blocked or reserved during fair week; the old note's 'extensions in writing around fair week' is no longer on the page and is dropped.

WEIGHT QUESTION (bridge): the page says 'Tuxedo Park main entrance (3 ton bridge) is located on Tuxedo Road from West 13th Street; back entrance is on Idaho Road from West 13th.' EKKO is ~9,500 lb empty (4.75 tons), so a real 3-ton limit would rule out the main entrance. The same page captions 'The new two-lane, concrete Tuxedo Park Bridge main entrance opened to traffic in April 2021', so the '3 ton' wording may be left over from the old bridge, and there is a back entrance from Idaho Road. I could not tell from imagery whether the Idaho Road entrance avoids a bridge. Needs AWH (or a call to 402-826-4315).

PIN (~250 m off, across the river): stored 40.62750,-96.97100 is on Tuxedo Road just south of the river bridge, outside the park. The river camping (RVs visible on NAIP and Esri along the south loop road, Cottonwood Rd) runs ~40.6283,-96.9744 to 40.6286,-96.9729; suggest 40.6284,-96.9737. The 10 baseball-field sites (Old Settlers Rd) are by Thom Stallard Legion Field, ~40.632,-96.974, ~400 m north in the same park (not a split).

WATERFRONT not waterfront stands (lead, not a change): the river sites sit on the river side of the south loop road, ~15-30 m from the Big Blue River (channel ~30-35 m wide on NAIP, so river-class), but a continuous treeline fills the whole bank between the pads and the water on both NAIP and Esri; that is a buffer, so no view or access. The baseball-field sites are ~300 m from the river. The stored treeline-screening evidence agrees.
PHONE 402-826-4315 confirmed (Parks and Recreation Office at City Hall). Website unchanged.
